sampleHeadings: 1. Discovery and eligibility check. We review your business registration, industry category, current digital presence, and goals to confirm exactly what's available to you today.

2. Strategy and context-hint planning. We map the questions and situations where your product or service is genuinely relevant inside a ChatGPT conversation, and draft ad creative and messaging around that.

3. Set up a readiness roadmap. If you're eligible, we set up your Ads Manager account structure, conversion tracking, and first campaign. If you're not yet eligible, we build a readiness package — creative, targeting strategy, and GEO alignment — ready to launch the moment access opens.

4. Monitoring and optimization. For live campaigns, we track performance against your goals and adjust bidding, creative, and context hints. For readiness clients, we monitor OpenAI's eligibility updates and flag when your market or account becomes eligible.

Google Ads Management Services in Bangladesh
1. Account audit or fresh setup. If you already have a Google Ads account, we review its history and structure first. If you're starting new, we set up the account and confirm access and billing.
2. Keyword and competitor research. We research what your potential customers actually search for, in both Bangla and English, and review what competitors are bidding on.
3. Campaign build. We structure campaigns by intent, write ad copy, and set up conversion tracking — this step is completed before launch, not left for later.
4. Launch and initial monitoring. Campaigns go live, and we watch performance closely during the first few weeks while Google's algorithm gathers data.
5. Ongoing optimization and reporting. We adjust bids, keywords, and ad copy based on real performance data, and send monthly reports showing what changed and why.

1. Local SEO Audit — Review current GBP setup, citation consistency, competitor rankings, and existing on-site local signals.

Our Full Stack Media Buying Or Paid Ad Services
1. Discovery & Audit — We review your business goals, target audience, competitors, and any existing ad accounts to understand what's working and what isn't.
2. Platform & Audience Assessment — Based on your funnel stage and audience, we determine which of the six platforms are worth investing in — and which aren't, yet.
3. Media Plan & Budget Allocation — You get a proposed budget split with the reasoning behind it, built around your funnel rather than an even percentage across channels.
4. Campaign Setup & Launch — Account structure, tracking (pixels, conversion APIs, tags), and an initial creative testing plan go live.
5. Ongoing Optimization — Bids, audiences, and budget shift toward what's performing, reviewed continuously using live analytics rather than left untouched between reports.

6. What We Offer — Platform-Specific Management Services
1. Social media audit — Current page performance, posting history, and platform fit are reviewed before any strategy is proposed.
2. Platform strategy — Based on the audit, the right platform mix and priority order are set for the business's specific audience.
3. Content calendar — A structured monthly calendar is built per platform, covering post type, format, and posting cadence.
4. Posting & community management — Content goes live on schedule, with comments and messages monitored and responded to.
5. Monthly reporting — Engagement, reach, and growth are reported against the goals set during strategy.
6. Optimization — Based on reporting, content mix, and posting times, adjustments are made the following month.
